indicator_definition: Proportion of the total population living in cities (urban areas), expressed as a percentage. Monitors urbanisation trends. Data compiled by Eurostat using the Degree of Urbanisation classification.
rationale: Cities drive growth but face challenges of congestion and inequality. Monitoring urbanisation helps plan for sustainable cities. Progress requires urban growth accompanied by adequate infrastructure and services.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled using the Degree of Urbanisation (DEGURBA) methodology. Cities defined as areas with at least 50,000 inhabitants and density above 1,500/km². Published periodically by Eurostat.
